security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: A fast, good-looking terminal for Windows
bundle.longDescription: Nebula Terminal is a Windows terminal for PowerShell, Command Prompt, Git Bash and WSL, with tabs, split panes and live visual customization.
